card.name: Linking words in clinical sign descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or the next word right after a sign or lab finding, such as 'to' after serum aminotransferases or 'consistent' after symptoms. It appears in warnings about liver injury or pancreatitis.

modes.label: Link after lab finding
modes.description: A word like 'to' or 'equal' that follows an elevated lab value and leads into a threshold.
modes.example: Signs and symptoms of liver injury, including elevation of serum aminotransferases<< to>> greater than 5-fold the upper limit

modes.label: Symptom wording
modes.description: The word 'consistent' or a comma after the word symptoms, leading into a condition or a list.
modes.example: or if symptoms<< consistent>> with acute HIV-1 infection develop following

modes.label: Completing a symptom phrase
modes.description: The final word of a symptom phrase, such as pain after abdominal.
modes.example: persistent or severe abdominal<< pain>> (sometimes radiating to the back)
